news.title: Scientists “truly astonished” by discovery that challenges Earth’s origin story
news.summary: A new study suggests Earth formed almost entirely from material in the inner Solar System, challenging the idea that water-rich material from beyond Jupiter played a major role. If correct, Earth’s water may have been present much closer to the young Sun than scientists previously thought.
